strategies.name: Tokens
strategies.description: Generates, multiplies, or exploits tokens for board presence, value, or sacrifice resources.
notes: An incidental token does not establish strong affinity; scale, type, and repeatability matter.

strategies.name: +1/+1 Counters
strategies.description: Uses +1/+1 counters as a resource for growth, value, or winning.
notes: Incidental counters without a payoff do not establish a dedicated plan.

strategies.name: Combo
strategies.description: Combines interdependent pieces to generate repeatable value or a win condition.
notes: Do not infer an infinite combo from isolated Oracle text; infinite-resource claims require review.

strategies.name: Artifacts
strategies.description: Uses artifacts as a resource, permanent theme, fuel, or value engine.
notes: Artifact type alone, without functional synergy, does not imply strong affinity.

strategies.name: Aggro
strategies.description: Applies early combat pressure, prioritizing speed and damage over long-term advantage.
notes: Generic combat damage alone does not demonstrate an aggressive plan.

strategies.name: Reanimator
strategies.description: Fills the graveyard and returns creatures or other permanents to the battlefield.
notes: Generic recursion from hand is not automatically reanimation.

strategies.name: Spellslinger
strategies.description: Casts spells, especially instants and sorceries, to generate value, threats, or a win.
notes: Spell density and cast payoffs matter more than card type alone.

strategies.name: Lifegain
strategies.description: Gains meaningful amounts of life and converts that gain into resources, scaling, or a win.
notes: Incidental life gain without a payoff should not automatically receive strong affinity.

strategies.name: Control
strategies.description: Answers opposing threats efficiently and seeks advantage in the long game.
notes: A single answer does not define a control plan.

strategies.name: Aristocrats
strategies.description: Turns creature deaths and sacrifices, especially of your own creatures, into value or damage.
notes: A combination of outlets, payoffs, and recurring bodies is stronger evidence.

strategies.name: Burn
strategies.description: Turns direct-damage spells and effects into pressure or a finishing plan.
notes: Generic combat damage is not sufficient evidence.

strategies.name: Ramp
strategies.description: Accelerates mana availability beyond the normal progression of land drops.
notes: A normal land drop is not ramp; this strategy is also a cross-deck service.

strategies.name: Lands Matter
strategies.description: Uses land count, land entry, land sacrifice, or land types for synergy or a win.
notes: Lands alone do not establish affinity without effects that use them.

strategies.name: Voltron
strategies.description: Concentrates buffs and protection on one threat to win through combat damage.
notes: Isolated keywords such as flying do not automatically make a card Voltron.

strategies.name: Midrange
strategies.description: Combines development, interaction, and efficient threats to win through the midgame.
notes: This is a broad affinity; do not automatically label every efficient card as midrange.

strategies.name: Enchantress
strategies.description: Use enchantment casts and entries to build a repeatable value engine.

strategies.name: Equipment
strategies.description: Attach and reuse Equipment to turn creatures into sustained threats.

strategies.name: Mill
strategies.description: Deplete opponents' libraries or convert their milled cards into resources.

strategies.name: Blink
strategies.description: Exile and return your permanents to reuse their entry abilities.

strategies.name: Graveyard
strategies.description: Stock your graveyard and use it as a recurring resource across card types.

strategies.name: Discard
strategies.description: Disrupt opponents by making them discard cards from hand.

strategies.name: Sacrifice
strategies.description: Trade permanents for resources and reward the act of sacrificing.

strategies.name: Clones
strategies.description: Copy permanents to reuse their characteristics and abilities.

strategies.name: Treasure
strategies.description: Produce Treasure as a resource for mana, artifact synergies, or sacrifice costs.

strategies.name: Auras
strategies.description: Attach Auras to amplify threats and maintain access to those attachments.

strategies.name: Card Draw
strategies.description: Build around additional card draw and effects that increase draw output.

strategies.name: Flying
strategies.description: Use flying threats and interactions that grant flying.

strategies.name: Group Slug
strategies.description: Pressure the whole table with recurring damage from shared actions.

strategies.name: Storm
strategies.description: Cast many spells in one turn to amplify a spell with storm.

strategies.name: Self-Mill
strategies.description: Move cards from your own library into your graveyard to fuel graveyard effects.

strategies.name: Stax
strategies.description: Use persistent restrictions to limit actions and constrain opponents' resources.

strategies.name: Landfall
strategies.description: Trigger payoffs when lands enter and create additional land-entry events.

strategies.name: Theft
strategies.description: Take control of other players' permanents to use their board resources.

strategies.name: Extra Combats
strategies.description: Generate extra combat phases to repeat attacks and combat triggers.

strategies.name: Infect
strategies.description: Use infect to deliver poison counters and proliferate to increase them.

strategies.name: Forced Combat
strategies.description: Use goad to make opposing creatures attack and steer combat.

strategies.name: Planeswalkers
strategies.description: Develop planeswalkers and support their loyalty abilities.

strategies.name: Vehicles
strategies.description: Build around Vehicles and the creatures that crew them.

strategies.name: Lifedrain
strategies.description: Win through opponent life loss, often while recovering life yourself.

strategies.name: Pillow Fort
strategies.description: Deter attacks against you with persistent combat restrictions.

strategies.name: -1/-1 Counters
strategies.description: Place -1/-1 counters to shrink opposing creatures and build counter synergies.

strategies.name: Cascade
strategies.description: Use cascade to cast an additional eligible spell from the library.

strategies.name: Populate
strategies.description: Populate to copy creature tokens already on your battlefield.

strategies.name: Dredge
strategies.description: Replace draws with dredge to stock your graveyard and recover dredge cards.

strategies.name: ETB
strategies.description: Gain value when your permanents enter the battlefield.

strategies.name: Extra Turns
strategies.description: Take additional turns to accumulate resources or close the game.

strategies.name: Self-Damage
strategies.description: Use damage to yourself as fuel for effects that reward taking damage.

strategies.name: Proliferate
strategies.description: Increase existing counters on chosen permanents and players.

strategies.name: Spell Copy
strategies.description: Copy spells on the stack or reward copying them.

strategies.name: Attack Triggers
strategies.description: Build around abilities that trigger when creatures attack.

strategies.name: Affinity
strategies.description: Reduce costs through the affinity keyword and supply the objects it counts.

strategies.name: Food
strategies.description: Create and spend Food tokens as resources.

strategies.name: Energy
strategies.description: Generate and stock energy counters to pay for repeatable abilities.

strategies.name: Defenders
strategies.description: Build around creatures with defender and effects that make their board presence useful.

strategies.name: Sagas
strategies.description: Use Saga chapters to accumulate value over several turns.

strategies.name: Modified Creatures
strategies.description: Exploit modified creatures with counters, Equipment, or Auras.

strategies.name: Monarch
strategies.description: Introduce the monarch and defend the crown to keep its recurring draw.

strategies.name: Cycling
strategies.description: Cycle cards to trade unused options for new draws and fuel cycling payoffs.

strategies.name: Go Wide
strategies.description: Build a large creature board and reward attacking with many bodies.

strategies.name: Anthems
strategies.description: Improve the strength of multiple creatures with a shared buff.

strategies.name: Tap / Untap
strategies.description: Untap permanents to reuse their abilities and get more from tapping them.

strategies.name: Counterspells
strategies.description: Interact with spells on the stack through counterspells.

strategies.name: Ninjutsu
strategies.description: Use ninjutsu to turn unblocked attacks into threats and combat triggers.

strategies.name: Morph
strategies.description: Deploy face-down spells and turn them face up for tactical value.

strategies.name: Unblockable
strategies.description: Make attackers unblockable to deliver reliable combat damage triggers.

strategies.name: Clues
strategies.description: Investigate or create Clues to bank card draw for later.

strategies.name: Flashback
strategies.description: Cast spells a second time from the graveyard using flashback.

strategies.name: Dungeon
strategies.description: Advance through dungeons to gain their room and completion effects.

strategies.name: Deathtouch
strategies.description: Use deathtouch to deter attacks and trade creatures efficiently.

strategies.name: Snow
strategies.description: Develop a snow permanent base to support snow costs and payoffs.

strategies.name: Mutate
strategies.description: Merge creature spells using mutate to reuse or stack mutate effects.

strategies.name: Flash
strategies.description: Deploy permanents with flash while holding mana for other plays.

strategies.name: Self-Discard
strategies.description: Discard your own cards to enable graveyard plays and discard payoffs.

strategies.name: Prowess
strategies.description: Turn noncreature spell casts into combat pressure via prowess.

strategies.name: Haste
strategies.description: Attack or use tap abilities with creatures as soon as they enter.

strategies.name: Bounce
strategies.description: Return permanents to hand for tempo or to reuse them.

strategies.name: Sea Creatures
strategies.description: Build around leviathans, krakens, octopuses, and serpents.

strategies.name: Scry
strategies.description: Use scry to control upcoming draws and enable scry payoffs.

strategies.name: Guildgates
strategies.description: Assemble Gates to enable Gate-based mana and victory payoffs.

strategies.name: Modular
strategies.description: Move +1/+1 counters between artifact creatures using modular.

strategies.name: Foretell
strategies.description: Set aside cards with foretell for later casting.

strategies.name: Surveil
strategies.description: Use surveil to improve upcoming draws and stock your graveyard.

strategies.name: Firebending
strategies.description: Use firebending attacks to generate mana for combat plays.

strategies.name: Annihilator
strategies.description: Force the defending player to sacrifice permanents through annihilator triggers.

strategies.name: Shrines
strategies.description: Build a board of Shrines whose effects scale with each other.

strategies.name: Madness
strategies.description: Cast cards with madness when you discard them.

strategies.name: Convoke
strategies.description: Tap creatures to help pay for spells with convoke.

strategies.name: Suspend
strategies.description: Use suspend to delay spells and cast them when their time counters run out.

strategies.name: Blood
strategies.description: Create Blood tokens and use them for card filtering or artifact value.

strategies.name: Myriad
strategies.description: Use myriad to copy an attacker against multiple opponents.

strategies.name: Deserts
strategies.description: Develop a Desert land base to support Desert-specific effects.

strategies.name: Indestructible
strategies.description: Use indestructible threats and effects that grant indestructible to preserve the board.

strategies.name: Mana Dorks
strategies.description: Use creatures that produce mana to accelerate development.

strategies.name: Evoke
strategies.description: Cast creatures for their evoke costs to reuse or exploit entry and sacrifice effects.

strategies.name: Offspring
strategies.description: Pay offspring costs to get a token copy of a creature as it enters.

strategies.name: Plot
strategies.description: Build around plot to prepare spells for a later turn.

strategies.name: Battles
strategies.description: Deploy battles and use combat to unlock their transformed rewards.

strategies.name: Kicker
strategies.description: Use optional kicker costs to scale spells or enable their upgraded effects.

strategies.name: Improvise
strategies.description: Tap artifacts to help pay for spells with improvise.

strategies.name: Menace
strategies.description: Use menace to make blocking difficult and pressure opponents.

strategies.name: Exploit
strategies.description: Use exploit to sacrifice creatures and trigger exploit payoffs.

strategies.name: Caves
strategies.description: Assemble Caves for their land and graveyard payoffs.

strategies.name: Squad
strategies.description: Pay squad costs to create token copies of creatures with squad.

strategies.name: Retrace
strategies.description: Discard lands to cast spells from the graveyard using retrace.

strategies.name: Training
strategies.description: Attack alongside stronger creatures to grow threats through training.

strategies.name: Legends
strategies.description: Build around legendary cards and effects that reward legendary spells or permanents.

strategies.name: Historic
strategies.description: Reward historic spells and permanents across artifacts, legendary cards, and Sagas.

strategies.name: Wheels
strategies.description: Replace each player's hand to reset resources or trigger discard and draw payoffs.

strategies.name: Commander Matters
strategies.description: Build around effects that specifically reward controlling, casting, or attacking with your commander.

strategies.name: Toolbox
strategies.description: Search the library for context-specific answers, resources, or finishers.
